G41.text: GRBL has no cutter compensation; only G40 is accepted.

G42.text: GRBL has no cutter compensation; only G40 is accepted.

G43.text: GRBL has no G43 H. Its tool length offset is G43.1 Z (dynamic), cancelled by G49.

G64.text: GRBL accepts only G61 for path control.

G96.text: GRBL has no constant surface speed.

G95.text: GRBL has no feed per revolution (G93 and G94 only).

M06.text: GRBL has no M6 tool change. Most senders pause or strip it; check yours.

M01.text: GRBL accepts M1 but ignores it (optional stop isn't supported).
